news_signals.headline: Palantir wins $400M NATO allied government AI analytics contract expansion across 12 member nations
news_signals.why: Confirms PLTR's dominance in government AI with geographic expansion. Contract size exceeded analyst expectations. Drives earnings estimate revisions higher and institutional accumulation.

news_signals.headline: Rocket Lab discloses Neutron heavy-lift rocket passes critical engine qualification milestone, accelerating 2027 launch timeline
news_signals.why: Neutron is the key to RKLB competing for $50B+ annual launch market. Engine qualification is the most critical development milestone. Timeline acceleration reduces execution risk premium in the stock.

news_signals.headline: Federal Reserve rate cut probability for November rises to 78% after softer-than-expected employment data
news_signals.why: UPST revenue is directly correlated to loan origination volumes which collapse at high rates and surge at lower rates. Rate cut expectations are the single most important variable for UPST valuation. 78% probability is a strong catalyst.

news_signals.headline: SoundHound AI secures design win for voice AI integration in 2.1 million annual vehicles with major European automaker
news_signals.why: Automotive is SoundHound's largest addressable market. Design wins with top OEMs validate technology and create multi-year recurring revenue. With 38% short interest, positive news creates fuel for short squeeze.
